verdict.rationale: The pack contains kitty documentation titled 'Hints' and 'Select and act on visible text', plus a page on customizing the kitten's matching and actions. Together they point to a first-party keyboard-driven feature for picking items from on-screen output and acting on them. The evidence is only page titles, though: nothing explicitly confirms URL or file-path detection, opening behavior, or mouse-click support. missing for 10: explicit documentation that URLs and file paths are detected and opened, evidence of click-to-open with the mouse, detail on the keyboard hint workflow, hands-on or community corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can open URLs and file paths from output by clicking them or selecting them from the keyboard
